summary: Fort Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its acquisition of 50.1% of Logia USA Inc., a fuel integrity solutions provider for data centers. On August 26, 2026, Fort issued 132,603 common shares (US$125,000) to founder Yair Harel, who continues as CEO under a consulting agreement. The deal includes a US$2.0 million credit facility with milestone-based tranches and potential share issuance up to 2,652,058 shares. An equity rebalancing mechanism may reduce Fort's stake to 5% upon certain sale milestones. The acquisition is arm's length with no finder's fee. Watch milestone triggers and rebalancing effects.
